provenance: Worked rows, not a pass. Copy to subclass-bases.json and fill until `seed_index.py --bases` is clean. Keys are `<class file>/<### heading verbatim>` — take them from `--list`, never retype them. A base profile is the subclass at ALL TWENTY levels with no multiclassing, scored in Act II: the zero-dip reference point, not a recommendation. `src` and `base_deps` are cache stamps written by `--bases --stamp`.

cleric/Life.why: The rescue ceiling of the list; nothing else on its table clears competent.

fighter/Battle Master.why: Three attacks at 11 with superiority dice on the short-rest clock; no outward answer at all.
uncertain: Whether Listo's manoeuvre list matches the 2024 rules is not stated in the class file.

cleric/Dream.why: The domain changes the flavour of the healing, not the shape of the body.

inquisitor/Zeal Inquisition.why: Subclasses are chosen at level 3 and the shipped install has a dangling subclass GUID there; the mod needs updating to 2.2.1.

cleric/Heavy armour / martial weapon tab.why: A planning table that sits inside the Domains section, so it parses as a heading.
